fields.name: id

fields.description: Employee's last name

fields.name: position
fields.description: Job title or position

name: Role
description: User roles and permissions for access control

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the role

fields.name: name
fields.description: Role name (e.g., Admin, Manager, User)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the role's purpose

fields.name: permissions
fields.description: List of permissions granted to this role

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the role is currently active

fields.description: Timestamp when the role was created

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the department

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the department

fields.name: code
fields.description: Short code or abbreviation for the department

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Employee ID of the department manager

fields.name: budget
fields.description: Annual budget allocated to the department

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the department is currently active

fields.name: createdAt

name: LeaveType
description: Types of leave available in the system

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave type

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the leave type (e.g., Annual Leave, Sick Leave)

fields.name: code
fields.description: Short code for the leave type (e.g., AL, SL, ML)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the leave type

fields.name: defaultDaysAllowed
fields.description: Default number of days allowed per year for this leave type

fields.name: requiresApproval
fields.description: Whether this leave type requires manager approval

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this leave type is currently active and available

name: ApprovalTask
description: Represents an approval task assigned to a manager

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the approval task

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who submitted the request

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Reference to the manager assigned to approve the task

fields.name: taskType
fields.description: Type of approval task (e.g., leave, expense, timeoff)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the approval (pending, approved, rejected)

fields.name: submittedDate
fields.description: Date when the approval task was submitted

fields.name: reviewedDate
fields.description: Date when the task was reviewed by the manager

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Manager's comments or notes regarding the approval decision

name: Notification
description: Stores notification records and delivery status for system-wide communications

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee receiving the notification

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of notification (e.g., leave_approval, task_assigned, system_alert)

fields.name: message
fields.description: Content of the notification message

fields.name: status
fields.description: Delivery status (pending, sent, delivered, failed, read)

fields.name: isRead
fields.description: Indicates whether the notification has been read by the recipient

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was created

fields.name: readAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was read

relationships.description: Each notification belongs to one employee

indexes.description: Optimize queries for unread notifications by employee
Optimize queries for notification delivery status

fields.description: Unique identifier for the email template

fields.name: name
fields.description: Template name for identification

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification this template is used for

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Email subject line with placeholder support

fields.name: body
fields.description: Email body content with placeholder support

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this template is currently active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when template was created

name: LeaveHistory
description: Historical record of all leave requests with complete details

fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave history record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who requested leave

fields.name: leaveTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of leave requested

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date of the leave period

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: End date of the leave period

fields.name: status
fields.description: Final status of the leave request (approved, rejected, cancelled)

fields.name: approvedBy
fields.description: Reference to the employee who approved or rejected the request

fields.name: recordedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when this history record was created

Links to the type of leave

name: Manager
description: Manager profile extending employee data with management-specific attributes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the manager

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the base employee record

fields.name: departmentId
fields.description: Department managed by this manager

fields.name: managementLevel
fields.description: Level of management (e.g., Team Lead, Senior Manager, Director)

fields.name: maxApprovalLimit
fields.description: Maximum number of days the manager can approve for leave requests

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the manager role is currently active

fields.name: assignedDate
fields.description: Date when the manager role was assigned

name: LeaveRequest
description: Employee leave request with approval tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave request

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee submitting the request

fields.name: leaveTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of leave being requested

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date of the leave period

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: End date of the leave period

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current approval status (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled)

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Employee's reason for requesting leave

fields.name: submittedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the request was submitted

constraints.dateValidation: endDate must be greater than or equal to startDate

name: ApprovalDecision
description: Records the manager's approval or rejection decision for leave requests

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the approval decision

fields.name: leaveRequestId
fields.description: Reference to the leave request being decided upon

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Reference to the manager making the decision

fields.name: decision
fields.description: The decision made (approved, rejected, pending)

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Manager's comments or reason for the decision

fields.name: decisionDate
fields.description: Date and time when the decision was made

relationships.description: Links to the leave request being decided
Links to the manager who made the decision

name: StatusLog
description: Audit trail of status changes for leave requests

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the status log entry

fields.name: leaveRequestId
fields.description: Reference to the leave request

fields.name: previousStatus
fields.description: Status before the change

fields.name: newStatus
fields.description: Status after the change

fields.name: changedBy
fields.description: Employee ID who triggered the status change

fields.name: changedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the status change occurred

fields.name: remarks
fields.description: Optional notes or comments about the status change

relationships.description: Each status log entry belongs to one leave request
Each status log entry is created by one employee

constraints.statusValues: newStatus should be one of: Pending, Approved, Rejected, Cancelled, Withdrawn
